framingPolicy.note: Reference crops use the same clothing-focused framing policy as the live capture (spec §3). Faces are incidental; crops should not clip coat sleeves or hems.

looks.description: Cruella's crimson ball gown: crinkled red satin halter gown with a high gathered neck, sweetheart bodice, fitted mermaid silhouette flaring to a pleated train with a thigh-high slit over a nude underlayer; long crimson opera gloves; slim black cane. Styling: split black-and-white hair, dark smoky eyes, red lip.

looks.label: Red Glamour

checklist.label: Crimson satin gown
checklist.why: The whole look starts here: blood-red satin with a halter neck and a mermaid line that flares at the hem.
checklist.search: red satin halter mermaid gown costume

checklist.label: Crimson opera gloves
checklist.why: Elbow-length red satin gloves turn a red dress into a villain’s entrance.

checklist.label: Slim black cane
checklist.why: A sleek black cane to lean on, point with, and tap impatiently.

checklist.label: Two-tone black-and-white wig
checklist.why: Cruella’s split hair is her signature; nothing says de Vil faster.

checklist.label: Bold red lipstick
checklist.why: A crimson lip to match the gown, sharp enough to sign a threat.

checklist.label: Dramatic smoky eyes
checklist.why: Dark, smudged eyes give the look its wicked glare.
